ask_chauffeur.description: Ask Chauffeur for a tool or skill you lack. Your listed tools work as usual, including on files outside the project: use them first, and ask only when none of them can do the job. Describe what you need to do in plain words, such as "drive a browser to check a page" or "create a Jira issue from the command line". Chauffeur may reveal hidden tools, point you to Code Mode tools, or hand over a skill; the reply says what you got. Ask before improvising a workaround.
ask_chauffeur.need: What you need to do, in plain words.
ask_chauffeur.nothing_found: Chauffeur has no extra tool or skill for that. Your listed tools are available as usual and nothing restricts them: do it with them.
ask_chauffeur.nothing_found_skill_tool: Chauffeur has no extra tool for that. If a skill fits, load it with the skill tool. Your listed tools are available as usual and nothing restricts them: do it with them.
ask_chauffeur.revealed: Chauffeur revealed these tools; they are available from your next step: {tools}.
ask_chauffeur.failed: Chauffeur could not answer: {error}. Continue with the tools you have.

todowrite.description: Write the todo list for this session: the distinct steps of the current task and where each stands. Use it for work with several steps: write the list before starting, keep one todo in_progress, mark each completed only when its evidence is in, and cancel any that no longer apply. Each call replaces the whole list. Chauffeur keeps a /goal going while any todo is pending or in progress.
todowrite.todos: The whole list, in order. Each call replaces the previous list.
todowrite.content: One distinct step, in a short sentence.
todowrite.status: pending, in_progress (one at a time), completed once its evidence is in, or cancelled.
todowrite.too_many: A todo list holds at most {max} items; merge some and write it again.
todowrite.heading: Todos ({open} open):

tool_descriptions.shell: Run a shell command and return its output. Quote paths with spaces. Prefer a dedicated tool when one fits. Large output is saved to a file and previewed. `timeout` is optional; background commands return at once and you are notified when they finish.
tool_descriptions.read: Read a file (text, image, or PDF) or list a directory. Text lines are prefixed `<line>: ` (1-based; not part of the file). For large files use offset and limit, preferring one larger read over many slices, or grep for the content.
tool_descriptions.question: Ask the user while you work: a preference, an unclear instruction, or a choice between approaches. A free-text answer is added automatically. `multiple: true` allows several picks. Put a recommended option first and end its label with "(Recommended)".
tool_descriptions.grep: Search file contents with a ripgrep regex or literal text, narrowed by `path` or `include`. Returns paths, line numbers, and previews.
tool_descriptions.webfetch: Fetch an HTTP(S) URL as markdown (default), text, or HTML. Read-only; prefer a more specific tool when one exists. Large results are previewed.
tool_descriptions.execute: Run JavaScript in the Code Mode runtime to call tools and combine their results. `fetch` works; imports, the filesystem, and timers do not. Call only tools listed in the Code Mode catalog or returned by `search`, by their exact path, keeping bracket notation such as `tools.ns["tool-name"](input)`. `return` the result (else the last expression is returned). Await calls that matter; run independent ones with `Promise.allSettled`.
tool_descriptions.patch:
Edit files with a patch:

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: <path>        then the contents, every line starting with +
*** Update File: <path>     optionally *** Move to: <new path>, then @@ hunks of -/+ lines
*** Delete File: <path>
*** End Patch

Every operation needs its header, and new lines always start with +. Example:

*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: src/app.py
@@ def greet():
-print("Hi")
+print("Hello")
*** End Patch
tool_descriptions.edit: Replace exact text in a file. Copy indentation exactly from read output and leave out its `<line>: ` prefix. oldString must match exactly once unless replaceAll is true; add surrounding context to make it unique. Use replaceAll for every occurrence, such as a rename.
tool_descriptions.write: Create or overwrite a file; missing folders are created. For partial changes use edit.

subagent.guidance: The user asks that subagents doing routine work, such as searching, reading and summarising, or mechanical edits, run on a cheaper model from your own provider: pass model "anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5" when you run on Claude Opus, or "openai/gpt-6-luna" when you run on GPT-6.1 Sol. Keep your own model for hard design, debugging or review.

rulebook.too_long: /{id} text is {kib} KiB; the limit is 64 KiB. Nothing was started: shorten it and try again.

model_router.continue: Chauffeur moved this session to {model} because {failed} failed: {error}. Continue where you left off.
model_router.stranded: Chauffeur moved this session to {model}, but it failed too ({error}), and no other model is left to try. Choose a model, then send a message to continue.
